resources.string: Other apps — 白い熊 自由作業盤 first of all — start commands in Termux through its RUN_COMMAND door. The door answers only while the switch below is on and the calling app holds the “Run commands in 白い熊 Termux environment” permission.
Every app that holds the “Run commands in 白い熊 Termux environment” permission will be able to run any command as Termux, with access to all of its files. Switch this on only for apps you trust.
Shows a dialog when Termux starts and external apps are not allowed.
Restricted — a command sent while Termux is in the background may not start. Tap to lift the restriction.
Not granted — needed to open a terminal session from the background. Tap to grant.

“allow-external-apps” is off, so other apps — 白い熊 自由作業盤 for one — cannot start commands in Termux; their requests fail with an error. It is switched on in the 白い熊 Termux UI settings, under “External apps”.
Accept commands only from trusted callers
Only the apps switched on below may run commands or restore data. A request from any other app is refused and recorded, even when the app holds the permission.
Every app that holds the permission will be able to run commands as Termux again, and the list below will no longer be asked.
No installed app requests the permission.
Signing certificate changed — refused. Switch off and on again to accept the new one.
Cannot read the signing certificate of %1$s.

This command was refused: “Accept commands only from trusted callers” is on and the request did not come through the trusted door. Trusted apps are chosen in the 白い熊 Termux UI settings, under “External apps”.
